text: Melanie, you can use cash held above your emergency reserve and near-term goals to close protection gaps, starting with life insurance for both of you since two young children rely on both incomes. Other places it could go are an umbrella policy, the high-rate credit card balance, or college saving for Liam and Josh. Think of one paycheck and several bills asking for it; using spare cash this way is like setting one bill aside so the family stays covered.
